svg.aria-label: Four separate measures: cleaning services, addressable work, robot equipment and supplier opportunity

g.text: The USD 40B industry claim belongs here; its scope is not disclosed.
2. Work a particular robot can address
Filter for facade geometry, access, surfaces, weather and acceptance.
Estimate fleet capacity, purchases and replacement separately.
Allow for delivery, local support, competition and customer budgets.
Service revenue does not convert directly into machine unit sales.
Conceptual framework. Box sizes do not represent measured market shares.
